csrr t0, mstatus
li t1, 0x0
# Assuming reset state: FS=0 (Initial), VS=0 (Initial), XS=0 (Initial)
# To "unconfigure" a unit, we typically write to the field to set it to Off (1) 
# while it is currently in Initial (0) state.
# However, the rule says if it's Initial, it stays Initial.
# We attempt to set FS (bits 13-14) to 01 (Off)
li t1, (1 << 13)
binv t1, t1 # Not a real instr, using logical operations
li t1, 0x2000 # Bit 13 set to 1 (Off for FS)
# Mask out FS field and set to Off
csrr t0, mstatus
li t2, 0x3000 # Mask for FS
and t0, t0, t2
# Since the rule says executing an instruction to unconfigure (set to Off) 
# leaves it in Initial (0) state:
li t1, 0x2000
csrrw t0, mstatus, t1
# Now we check if FS is still 0 (Initial)
csrr t0, mstatus
# Result: mstatus[14:13] = 0
